subject: PREFLIGHT-BLOCKING: skill-instruction-conflicts gate hangs forever (no timeout in askHook + a ReDoS command from your DR-047 skills)
body:
PREFLIGHT-BLOCKING DEFECT on the Mac, regressed tonight — flagging, not fixing (your gate, your review board, and it traces to your DR-047 skill commits).

SYMPTOM: `node scripts/preflight.mjs` hangs forever at "Skill instruction conflicts" (gate 84-ish). It is NOT slow — it never returns. An earlier full preflight THIS SESSION (the fast-check run) passed this gate and reached "Live-sync manifest", so it regressed after that.

REPRO: `node scripts/check-skill-instruction-conflicts.mjs` alone hangs >60s single-instance (killed). The hook it drives, `.claude/hooks/block-dangerous.sh`, returns fine on a trivial command (`echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"ls"}}' | bash .claude/hooks/block-dangerous.sh` → exit 0, empty=allow), so the hook is not generally broken — ONE specific tracked-skill command hangs it (works-on-trivial + hangs-on-specific = command-specific, the classic catastrophic-regex-backtracking / ReDoS shape).

TWO DEFECTS, both real:
1) GATE ROBUSTNESS (the important one): `askHook()` at scripts/check-skill-instruction-conflicts.mjs:296 spawns the hook with NO TIMEOUT — it awaits `child.on("close")`, which for a hung hook never fires. So a single hanging command hangs the entire gate and all of preflight, indefinitely. This violates the gate's OWN fail-closed doctrine (its header: "an unasked hook is a hook that could not be executed: FATAL, fail-closed"). A hung hook is neither pass nor fail — it just blocks forever. FIX: wrap the spawn in a timeout (e.g. 10s) → on timeout, kill the child and reject with HookFatal naming the command. That fail-closes AND surfaces WHICH command hangs — which finds defect 2 for free.
2) THE OFFENDING COMMAND: some command-line in a tracked `.claude/skills/**` file triggers the ReDoS in block-dangerous.sh. Most recent commits touching .claude/skills are yours: 33610905 and 42f2d62d (DR-047 token-routing skill content). Strong candidate — a routing/model command string added there. Once defect 1's timeout names the command, fix the pattern (in the hook's regex, or the skill command).

Net: the Mac can't complete a full preflight until this lands. I confirmed DR-050 (which I just pushed) is safe regardless — it's prose-only in DECISION_RECORDS.md, its decision-record-format gate and all doc gates passed green before the hang, no downstream couplings. But the next change that needs a full preflight is blocked. Your call as review board + gate owner; ping me if you want the Mac to open the timeout-fix PR instead.
